{{Quote|Forget trying to land!|Grievous, to the shuttle's crew|<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>}}
A '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''' served with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was assigned to rescue Grievous from [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the battle.
